plan.title: API Stubs + Workspace CRUD Shell

task.description: Create Workspace/Projects CRUD endpoints (UI-only shell, no RAG scoping): GET /api/v1/projects (paginated list with total count), POST /api/v1/projects (create workspace: name required, description, include_folders, exclude_folders, tags, system_prompt, default_model_id), PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id} (update), DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id} (delete). All behind JWT auth, RLS-scoped to current user. Create stub endpoints: GET /api/v1/models (returns empty list — wired Phase 2), GET /api/v1/models/embedding (returns empty list), GET /api/v1/settings (returns 501 — wired Phase 2), PUT /api/v1/settings (returns 501). Create Pydantic schemas for projects and common pagination.
task.files: server/app/api/projects.py, server/app/api/models.py, server/app/api/settings.py, server/app/schemas/project.py, server/app/schemas/common.py, server/app/schemas/models.py, server/app/schemas/settings.py
task.verification: Projects CRUD works end-to-end. Stub endpoints return expected status codes. Pagination includes total count. RLS isolation verified.
task.done-condition: Workspace CRUD operational, stubs return correct status codes, all routes registered in main.py

plan.dependencies: PLAN-1-4 depends on PLAN-1-1 (needs app skeleton, models, dependencies.py)
